5385-74400.title: Skai > Governance > Proposals > Delegation 1VH (1440 x 900px)
5385-74400.notes: READ LIVE (get_design_context on the Delegates table 5385:74600 and on the off-chain card 5385:74567 — the two wave 41 measured and left as hand-offs). BUILT in fcd96c2ec, both, to the frame's geometry with the unavailable state Casey's ruling calls for. Delegates (new src/components/governance/DelegatesTable.tsx): the head is inset 32 with 6px above and below, every cell Manrope Regular 12/16 -4% #95A09F, widths in the frame's order S/N 120, User 500, Voting power 100, 7D change 150 centred, Number of delegators 200, Action 179.14 right-aligned, closed by a 1px rule. NO ROWS ARE DRAWN and that is the point: there is no delegate registry, SKAIGovernor exposes no per-delegate power read and no delegator count, and nothing holds a seven-day series, so every column but S/N would have to be invented. An empty table would read as "nobody is a delegate", which this app cannot claim. The per-row Delegate (5385:75081) and Remove (5385:75165) controls are absent for the same reason — a control needs a row to act on, and adding one would mean a delegate call against an address nothing supplied. Off-chain (new OffChainDelegationCard.tsx): #03383E, 32px padding, an 8px top-right radius over a 24px bottom-right, the title at Manrope Regular 24/28 -4% and the frame's own paragraph at 16/22 and 64%, then the `Wallet address` label 8px above a #001615 field on a 16px radius with a 1px #123F3C border and 22/16 padding, carrying the `0x ...` placeholder and the #56C7F3 DELEGATE affordance. THE FIELD IS INERT AND SAYS WHY: partial and expiring delegation needs a share and an expiry, snapshotService reads existing delegations and writes none, and delegateVote takes an address only — wiring the control to it would silently delegate the user's FULL power with no expiry, the opposite of what the card offers. NOT BUILT, measured: the 200x34 `Search delegates` field and the two 140x34 selects above the table, which filter a list that has no source. STILL OPEN from wave 41: the frame's `Your power` value is a VOTE count (5385:74537) for which the governor exposes no read.
